mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hr_interview (company_id, application_id, interviewer_id, candidate_id, job_id, scheduled_at, method, location, remark, candidate_note, status) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{applicationId}, #{interviewerId}, #{candidateId}, #{jobId}, #{scheduledAt}, #{method}, #{location}, #{remark}, #{candidateNote}, #{status})
mapper.sql: id, company_id, application_id, interviewer_id, candidate_id, job_id, scheduled_at, method, location, remark, candidate_note, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hr_interview WHERE ORDER BY scheduled_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT i.id, i.company_id, i.application_id, i.interviewer_id, i.candidate_id, i.job_id, i.scheduled_at, i.method, i.location, i.remark, i.candidate_note, i.status, i.created_at, i.updated_at FROM hr_interview i LEFT JOIN hr_interview_evaluation ev ON ev.interview_id = i.id AND ev.is_draft = 0 WHERE i.company_id = #{companyId} AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND i.interviewer_id = #{interviewerId} AND ev.id IS NULL ORDER BY i.scheduled_at ASC
